name: Unpack / Convert
description: Extracts ZIP/RAR archives, CUE bundles, SACD ISOs and DSD (.dsf/.dff) files when present. Converts all audio formats to .mp3 VBR(V0), and renames files to MetaForge standard. Does file directory sanitation: moves all graphic assets to an 'art' folder, deletes legacy cruft, and preserves any source file it could not process.
